title: Decision tree depth and tail indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs on the coordinates outside $J$. Write $D$ for the depth of the decision tree computing the resulting restricted function, and for each $k$ let $I_k$ be $1$ if $k\le D$ and $0$ otherwise. Then $2^D=1+\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}2^j I_{j+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the binary cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
a sign assignment is fixed on coordinates outside $J$
